readOrder: bounded outer ZIP headers, at most 1 MiB, no Authorization forwarded to storage
official pinned download-artifact action for the complete existing ZIP
entry CRC32 plus gzip EOF/CRC and non-extracting tar inspection
external completed-job-log gate for the complete ZIP SHA256
stopConditions: unexpected ZIP header, path, or metadata

configComparison.candidate: PGO-generate intended configuration; compiled values must be observed
configComparison.originalFailure: non-PGO intended debug configuration; compiledDebug previously unverified

signingScopeClarification: Ad-hoc signing of disposable isolated test copies remains permitted in a later separately authorized test phase; product signing and publication are outside this inspection.
publicEvidencePolicy: Public source, workflow, run and artifact identities plus bounded typed configuration summaries and hashes. No credentials, signed download URLs or raw configuration.
